name: Anthony Rene
bio:
Anthony specializes in sports performance and functional training for clients of all fitness levels. As a former Division 1 track and field athlete with a Bachelor of Science in Exercise Science, he brings 15+ years of experience designing goal-oriented programs that challenge clients to safely push past their limits. Anthony’s approach blends athletic expertise with thoughtful coaching to help clients build strength, improve performance, and become the best version of themselves.

‍

Qualifications & Experience

  1. 15 plus years in sports and performance training.
  2. Bachelor of science in exercise science.
  3. Former division 1 track and field athlete
  4. Adept at exercise programming for various fitness levels.

name: Avani Johnson
bio:
Avani works with individuals across the lifespan to improve movement quality, strength, and resilience. She specializes in functional strength training, mobility, injury prevention, and sports conditioning for those managing chronic illness, injury, disability, or movement disorders. Her evidence-informed, adaptable approach supports both rehabilitation-minded clients and active individuals seeking safe, sustainable performance.

‍

Qualifications & Experience

  1. Chronic illness/injury across the lifespan
  2. Sports and strength conditioning/injury prevention.
  3. Functional strength training and mobility across the lifespan.
  4. Disability and movement disorders

‍

name: Barbara Edes
bio:
Barbara specializes in functional strength, mobility, and heart-rate–guided cardio training for adults 40 and beyond. A highly experienced NASM-certified personal trainer and yoga instructor, she integrates strength, spinning, aerial skills, and breath-centered yoga to support flexibility, balance, and mind–body connection. Barbara’s thoughtful approach delivers more than a workout — helping clients build confidence, move with intention, and reconnect with their bodies.

‍

Qualifications & Experience

  1. Functional strength and mobility for adults 40+
  2. Cardio specialist to oversee heartrate guided training
  3. Aerial skills for strength, flexibility and fun!
  4. Yoga, emphasizing breathwork, flexibility, and mind body connection.

‍

name: Barton David
bio:
Barton brings over 20 years of experience guiding clients of all ages toward healthier, more capable movement. A MAYO Clinic–trained health and wellness coach, he specializes in functional strength, cardio, and mobility, with focused support for weight loss, metabolic health, and corrective exercise. His coaching-driven approach helps adults, seniors, youth, and athletes build sustainable habits and enjoy movement for life.

‍

Qualifications & Experience

  1. MAYO clinic trained health and wellness coach.
  2. Functional strength, cardio, and mobility training for all ages.
  3. Weight loss, metabolic health, corrective exercise.
  4. Senior, youth, and athletic training

‍

name: Christi Simmons
bio:
Christi is a Master of Science in Kinesiology/Exercise Physiology–trained coach who focuses on form, technique, and functional fitness for all ages. Christi’s collegiate Basketball,  Track & Field and National Champion Cycling back ground, along with her education, help give her the experience and knowledge to develop individual programs that get results. She specializes in biomechanics, sports performance, and senior strength, balance, and mobility, while also leading small group and high-intensity programs including spin, TRX, kettlebell, HIIT classes, Speedflex, and boxing, helping clients move safely, build strength, and reach their fitness goals.

‍

Qualifications & Experience

  1. Functional training
  2. Biomechanics and sports performance.
  3. Senior Strength and mobility
  4. Group training

name: David Morin
bio:
Dave specializes in functional mobility, strength, and muscular endurance for clients of all ages, with a focus on golf-specific mobility, kettlebell training, sports preparedness, injury prevention, and senior fitness. An ACSM–certified personal trainer and Precision Nutrition–certified health coach, he integrates rotational core strength and athletic agility to support safe, effective movement. Dave’s guidance-driven approach honors the body as a gift, helping clients build strength, improve performance, and enjoy lifelong fitness.

‍

Qualifications & Experience

  1. Sports preparedness and injury prevention
  2. Senior fitness training. Sitting and standing
  3. Fall and balance prevention programing
  4. Kettlebell certified specialist.

‍

name: Donna Mazow
bio: Donna attended the University of Texas at Austin and is a NASM certified personal trainer. Donna works hard to tailor her programs to the client's level, assist in setting realizable goals and when met makes getting to the next level achievable. Donna’s mission is to help her clients feel strong, confident and most of all feel healthy and happy!

name: Emily Field
bio:
Emily brings over 26 years of experience supporting strength, mobility, and long-term wellness across the lifespan. A Senior Fitness Training Specialist with advanced expertise in orthopedic and post-cancer training, she designs evidence-based programs that prioritize safe progression, functional strength, and resilience. Her background as a marathon champion informs a thoughtful, performance-aware approach — helping clients rebuild, maintain, and optimize movement with confidence.

‍

Qualifications & Experience

  1. Senior Fitness Training Specialist
  2. Orthopedic Training Specialist
  3. Post Cancer Training specialist

‍

Joey brings firsthand experience in transformation, having lost 110 pounds and maintained his results through sustainable training. He specializes in athlete conditioning, strength development, and HIIT programming for clients of all fitness levels. Joey’s confidence-driven, goal-focused coaching empowers clients to build strength, improve performance, and achieve lasting results.

‍

Qualifications & Experience

  1. Sustainable weight loss
  2. Athlete Training
  3. Confidence Driven Coaching
  4. Biceps and Shoulder Strength

name: Mark Kimrey
bio: Mark has over 20 years of experience in strength and conditioning and fitness with credentials including NSCA CSCS, USA Weightlifting, USA Track and Field, USA Powerlifting, and CrossFit Level 1, as well as B.S. in Exercise Science. He specializes in sports performance, strength, speed, power development, and metabolic conditioning. Mark loves helping people reach their goals, realize their full human potential, and keeping them functional for everyday life.

name: Rachel Levin
bio: Born and raised in Dallas, I grew up within our community, went to the University of Denver, and came back to Dallas as a teacher. All the while, my love for health and fitness grew. Years of training competitively have helped me to gain the knowledge and experience to provide personalized workouts that are both efficient and effective.

name: Rachelle Toller
bio:
Rachelle supports clients across the lifespan with a focus on pre- and post-natal fitness, helping individuals build strength, confidence, and safe movement through every stage. A Precision Nutrition–certified coach with advanced training in senior fitness, she integrates movement and nutrition to support long-term health. Her performance-based approach emphasizes progressive overload and custom programming, helping clients train intelligently and stay prepared for the activities and adventures they enjoy.

‍

Qualifications & Experience

  1. Senior exercise specialist program
  2. Pre and post natal fitness programing
  3. Performance strength training, progressive overload focus with custom programming

‍

bio:
Juan is passionate about helping people achieve their goals, whether focused on fitness, health, or overall lifestyle improvement. Through customized training programs and individualized coaching, Juan helps clients transform both their minds and bodies while building sustainable habits for long-term success. He believes true progress starts with the right mindset and that, with dedication, consistency, and a personalized plan, even the most challenging goals can be achieved.

‍

  3. Hard Gainer Programming
  4. Athletic Training & Muscular Endurance
